title: Tseitin auxiliary assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, let $w$ be a natural number, and let $a\in\{\pm1\}^n$ be an assignment. The assignment on the $(w-3)|F|$ auxiliary variables is defined coordinatewise: an auxiliary coordinate determines a clause position and a within-clause auxiliary position, and its value is the corresponding coordinate of the local assignment for that clause.
caveat: The local assignment's construction and the auxiliary-coordinate indexing equivalence are not defined in the supplied snippet.
